title: Easy Pasta Recipes
excerpt: Find easy pasta recipes for weeknights and Sunday supper—lasagna, creamy chicken pasta, baked pasta, pasta salads, and crockpot noodles, all gathered in one cozy guide.
featuredImageAlt: Easy pasta recipes featuring lasagna, creamy chicken pasta, and a family dinner table
contentHtml:
When you need a supper that feels both comforting and doable, pasta recipes are hard to beat. A bubbling lasagna, a creamy skillet chicken pasta, a crockpot spaghetti, or a cool pasta salad can all belong on a family table. This guide gathers Grandma Recipe’s best easy pasta recipes by style—lasagna, creamy chicken pasta, baked pasta, pasta salads, and slow cooker noodles—so you can pick a path and cook with confidence.

Use this page as your starting point. Each section below links to tested recipes with clear steps, familiar ingredients, and that cozy, from-scratch flavor we love for weeknights and Sundays alike.

How to Use This Pasta Recipes Guide

Start with the kind of pasta night you want, then choose a recipe that fits your time:

  • Short on time? Try a creamy skillet pasta, orzo, marinara pasta, or a simple Alfredo toss.
  • Want something cozy? Open lasagna, baked ziti, million dollar spaghetti, or lasagna soup.
  • Feeding a crowd? Baked pasta, crockpot lasagna, and pasta salads travel well to potlucks.
  • Need a make-ahead option? Slow cooker pasta and chilled pasta salads do some of the work for you.

If you want a classic layered dinner, begin with Homemade Vegetarian Lasagna. For a weeknight skillet, start with Marry Me Chicken Pasta or Tuscan Chicken Pasta.

Pasta Cooking Basics

A few steady habits keep pasta recipes tasting like home:

  • Salt the pasta water so the noodles themselves have flavor.
  • Cook pasta just to al dente when it will finish in a sauce or bake, so it does not turn soft.
  • Save a little pasta water for creamy sauces—it helps the sauce cling.
  • Layer lasagna generously but keep sauces spreadable so every bite stays moist.
  • Rest baked pasta briefly before cutting so slices hold together.

Lasagna Recipes

Lasagna is Sunday supper in a pan—layers of noodles, sauce, and cheese that make the whole kitchen smell inviting.

  • Homemade Vegetarian Lasagna — garden vegetables, ricotta, and golden mozzarella.
  • Crockpot Lasagna — hands-off lasagna for busy days.
  • Cozy Lasagna Soup — all the lasagna flavor in a cozy bowl.
  • Manicotti and Cannelloni Pasta — stuffed pasta shells and tubes with classic cheese fillings.
  • Stuffed Shells — stuffed shells ready for a saucy bake.

Serve lasagna recipes with garlic bread and a simple green salad. Leftovers reheat beautifully the next day.

Creamy Chicken Pasta Recipes

Chicken and pasta belong together on busy nights. Creamy sauces, skillet dinners, and slow cooker Alfredo all earn a place here.

  • Marry Me Chicken Pasta — creamy sun-dried tomato comfort in one skillet.
  • Tuscan Chicken Pasta — garlic, greens, and tender chicken with pasta.
  • Crack Chicken Penne — rich, cheesy penne the whole table finishes.
  • Crockpot Chicken Alfredo Pasta — hands-off Alfredo for crockpot evenings.
  • Homemade Alfredo Sauce — a homemade Alfredo sauce to pour over any pasta.
  • Cajun Chicken and Sausage Pasta and Cajun Pasta — Cajun warmth with chicken or sausage.
  • Lemon Chicken Orzo — bright lemon chicken with tender orzo.

Baked Pasta Recipes

Baked pasta is potluck-friendly and family-proof—cheese on top, sauce underneath, and a golden finish from the oven.

  • Chicken Baked Ziti — chicken baked ziti for a hearty casserole night.
  • Million Dollar Spaghetti — layered spaghetti with a rich, cheesy middle.
  • Easy Vegetable Pasta Bake — vegetable pasta bake with a golden cheese topping.
  • Cheesy Ravioli and Spinach Ricotta Ravioli — ravioli dinners with simple sauce and melt.
  • Macaroni and Cheese and Cheeseburger Macaroni — classic macaroni comfort, plain or skillet-style.

Make-ahead tip: assemble most baked pasta dishes earlier in the day, refrigerate, then bake until bubbling before supper.

Pasta Salad Recipes

Pasta salads are the cool side of the pasta family—perfect for lunches, picnics, and easy dinner spreads.

  • Italian Pasta Salad — bright Italian pasta salad with fresh vegetables.
  • Bow Tie Pasta Salad — creamy bow-tie pasta salad.
  • BLT Pasta Salad — bacon, tomato, and lettuce in pasta form.
  • Deviled Egg Pasta Salad — deviled-egg flavor in a pasta salad bowl.
  • Crab Pasta Salad — creamy crab pasta salad for a lighter lunch plate.

Crockpot and Slow Cooker Pasta

Slow cooker pasta recipes turn busy days into noodle-night victories. Add the ingredients, let time help, and come home to a kitchen that already smells like supper.

  • Crockpot Lasagna — layered lasagna without hovering at the stove.
  • Crockpot Chicken Alfredo Pasta — creamy chicken Alfredo pasta.
  • Crockpot Spaghetti — classic spaghetti with less hands-on time.

Simple Sauces and Everyday Pasta

Not every pasta night needs a long bake. Sometimes a good sauce and a quick noodle are enough.

  • Marinara Pasta — simple marinara pasta for a reliable weeknight plate.
  • Orzo Pasta — orzo as a cozy side or light main.
  • Beef Short Rib Ragu — beef short rib ragu when you want a richer sauce night.
  • Homemade Alfredo Sauce — homemade Alfredo to keep in your back pocket.

What to Serve with Pasta

  • Garlic bread, warm rolls, or focaccia
  • A crisp green salad or simple roasted vegetables
  • Extra Parmesan and fresh herbs at the table
  • A light dessert if Sunday supper needs a sweet finish

Make Ahead, Storage, and Leftovers

  • Refrigerate cooked pasta dishes within 2 hours in covered containers. Use within 3 to 4 days.
  • Freeze cooled baked pasta or sauce portions in airtight containers for up to 2 to 3 months.
  • Reheat gently until steaming hot. Add a splash of water, broth, or milk to loosen creamy sauces.
  • Leftover ideas: lunch bowls, baked leftover pasta with extra cheese, or soup add-ins.

FAQs About Pasta Recipes

Should I undercook pasta for baked recipes?

Yes. Pull it a minute or two early so it finishes softening in the oven without turning mushy.

How do I keep lasagna from getting watery?

Drain vegetables well, avoid overly thin sauce, and let the lasagna rest before slicing. Homemade Vegetarian Lasagna walks through a reliable layered method.

Can I make creamy pasta ahead?

You can, but reheat gently with a splash of liquid. Crockpot Alfredo and skillet pastas are often best the day they are made.

Which pasta recipe should I make first?

For a classic dinner, make Homemade Vegetarian Lasagna or Chicken Baked Ziti. For a quick weeknight, choose Marry Me Chicken Pasta, Tuscan Chicken Pasta, or Marinara Pasta.

Are pasta salads good for make-ahead lunches?

Yes. Italian Pasta Salad, Bow Tie Pasta Salad, and BLT Pasta Salad hold well when chilled and packed for the next day.

Final Thoughts

Good pasta recipes do not need complicated tricks—just sturdy noodles, a sauce that tastes like home, and a method that fits your night. Bookmark this guide, pick a cluster, and cook one recipe at a time. Before long you will have a reliable rotation for lasagna Sundays, creamy skillet nights, and easy pasta salads.
